lines.t: In my times of trouble, in my times of need
When darkness was all around, you were by me
Through every storm, every sorrow, you were there
When I was lost, you were my home
When I was cold, you kept me warm
When I had strayed, you waited, you called me
When I came back, you welcomed me with open arms
When I rebelled, you didn't give up on me
When I was blind, you helped me to see
Yeah, who's to warn? You've always been there
In every whisper of the night, in every tear I cry
You were my comfort, you were my guide
When darkness tried to pull me down
You were always around
When I felt alone
Your love always hung in me up
You've always been there
When I felt the heavy burden
Your mistakes from yesterday Through every doubt, every failure
You helped me When I was weak, you made me strong
When I was dead wrong, you held me along When I fell down, you lifted me up
Yeah, who's to blame?
I know you're not
I had searched to the ends of the earth
Trying to find something true
But then I realized someone had been there all along
It had been you
When I rebelled, you didn't give up on me
When I was blind, you, you helped me to see
Yahushua, you've always been there
In every whisper of the night
In every tear I cry
You were my comfort, you were my guide
When darkness tried to pull me down
You were always around
When I felt alone, I knew you were always hanging me up
You've always been there
Through every day
I feel your presence steady
In moments of silence
Your love echoes clear
Turning every fear into faith
This mirage in every tear
Yeah, who's your love?
Forever I'll sing
And you, my soul, will always cling
Oh, yeah, for sure
You've always been there
